lines.japanese: 「なるほど、おっしゃる通りっすね。いまの説明でよく分かりました。すでに俺の中で友人として確立しちゃってるおふたりを、いまから恋愛対象として考えるのはたしかに無理っぽいす」
lines.english: “I see. That makes sense. I couldn't start looking at you two as potential girlfriends now; in my head, you're already friends.”

lines.japanese: 「失礼な話だなオイ」
lines.english: “That's a damn rude thing to say.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！　先に同じこと俺に言ったくせして！？」
lines.english: “What!? You said the exact same thing about me first!”

lines.japanese: 「私が千歳に言うのはいいけど、千歳が私に言うのは納得いかない」
lines.english: “It's fine when I say it to you. I object when you say it to me.”

lines.japanese: 「あんた何様！？」
lines.english: “Who the hell do you think you are!?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、だけどこうやって軽口言いあえるのも友達だからだよね」
lines.english: “Ha ha. But being able to trade jabs like this is part of being friends.”

lines.japanese: 「そーねー。じゃあ千歳、うちら友達としておまえのレンアイ応援してやるから。感謝しろよ」
lines.english: “True enough. All right, Chitose. As your friends, we'll cheer on your love life. Be grateful.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、なんか余計なことされそうで逆に不安！」
lines.english: “Why does that make me even more afraid you're going to meddle!?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、平気平気。私たちの応援は気持ちだけだから。やだよね、えりちゃん。ヘタにキューピッドして、あとで恨まれたりとか」
lines.english: “Oh, don't worry. Moral support only. Right, Eri? We're not about to play Cupid and have her resent us afterward.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー。あんなしょーもないオトコとくっつけやがってー、みたいに文句言われてもねえ？」
lines.english: “Exactly. We don't want her complaining that we stuck her with some worthless man, do we?”

lines.japanese: 「アレッ！　ぼくたち友達ですよねえ！？」
lines.english: “Hey! I thought we were friends!?”

lines.japanese: なあんておどけてはみますが、いえいえ、そのお気持ちだけで有難いってなもんです。
lines.english: I joked, but honestly, moral support alone was more than enough.

lines.japanese: 片想いのときって、些細な優しさだけでも心強くなれるんですよねえ。
lines.english: When your love is still one-sided, even the smallest kindness can give you courage.

lines.japanese: はあ、がんばろ。
lines.english: Sigh. Better keep trying.

lines.japanese: 「ま、そんなわけでうちら三人、今後とも助けあっていこうぜい、みたいな？　ね、いんじゃないコレ」
lines.english: “So there you have it. From now on, the three of us help each other out. How about it? Sounds good, right?”

lines.japanese: 「そっすね！　黄金のトライアングル、誰も傷付かない理想的な関係っすよね！」
lines.english: “Right! The golden triangle—an ideal relationship where nobody gets hurt!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ？　千歳君はこれから傷付いてくかもしれないけどね」
lines.english: “Who knows? You might be the one getting hurt from here on out, Chitose.”

lines.japanese: にこにこ笑いながらとんでもないこと言いましたよ、このおねーさん。
lines.english: What an appalling thing to say with such a sweet smile.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううっ……やっぱりぼくはフラれてしまうのか……」
lines.english: “U-uuugh... Am I truly doomed to get shot down...?”

lines.japanese: 「まーまー、望み薄いとはいえ、まだ決まったわけじゃないんだから元気だせよ」
lines.english: “There, there. Your chances may be lousy, but it isn't settled yet. Cheer up.”

lines.japanese: 「はい……まさか英里子さんに慰めていただく日が来るとは思いませんでした……ううう」
lines.english: “Yes... I never imagined I’d live to see the day Eriko comforted me... Uuuugh.”

lines.japanese: 「紀奈子さーん、千歳いじりは私の専売特許なんだから勝手に取らないでよー」
lines.english: “Kinako, picking on Chitose is my department. Don't muscle in.”

lines.japanese: 「だーって、恋愛対象として無理とかきっぱり言ってくれちゃって、失礼な話だなオイ」
lines.english: “Buut he flat-out said he could never see me that way. That's a damn rude thing to say.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、根に持ってたんだ……」
lines.english: “Oh. You were holding a grudge...”

lines.japanese: 「や、だからそれは、先にそちらが俺のことを……！」
lines.english: “But as I keep saying, you were the ones who said it about me first...!”

lines.japanese: 「私が千歳君に言うのはいいけど、千歳君が私に言うのは納得いかない」
lines.english: “It's fine when I say it to Chitose. I object when Chitose says it to me.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえらホント何様っ！？」
lines.english: “Who the hell do you two think you are!?”

lines.japanese: 「ロマンスの神様」
lines.english: “The Goddess of Romance.”

lines.japanese: 「まじで！」
lines.english: “Seriously!?”

lines.japanese: 「横ぴぃーす☆」
lines.english: “Sideways peace sign! ☆”

lines.japanese: 「まあでも、たしかにふたりとも、やたら男女の機微に詳しいみたいっすもんねえ。いやあ、きっとこれまでに、よほど豊富な恋愛経験を積んで──」
lines.english: “Still, you both seem to know an awful lot about romance. I can only imagine the wealth of experience you've built up over the years—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、あれ？　えっ？　あの、すいません、なんで急にお二方とも目を逸らして？　紀奈子さん？」
lines.english: “—wait. Huh? Um, excuse me, but why did you both suddenly look away? Kinako?”

lines.japanese: 「ノーコメント」
lines.english: “No comment.”

lines.japanese: 「英里子さん？」
lines.english: “Eriko?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うるせーな！　ひとを殺したことなきゃ殺人犯を咎める権利ないのかよ！」
lines.english: “S-shut up! Do you have to murder somebody before you're allowed to condemn a murderer!?”

lines.japanese: 「なんか逆ギレしてるー！？」
lines.english: “Now she's mad at me because I embarrassed her!?”
